title: Backblaze B2 Lifecycle Rules
description: Lifecycle rules for a Backblaze B2 bucket.

fileNamePrefix.description: File name prefix this lifecycle rule applies to. Use an empty string to match every object.

daysFromUploadingToHiding.description: Days after upload before B2 hides matching objects. Use null to disable automatic hiding.

daysFromHidingToDeleting.description: Days after an object is hidden before B2 deletes it. Use null to keep hidden versions.
